name.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Cranbrook Conference Centre

description.value: A mid-scale chain hotel in Cranbrook operated by Wyndham Hotels and Resorts, located at 600 Cranbrook Street North in the heart of the East Kootenay region. The property includes a conference centre, making it one of the larger lodging options in the area. Cranbrook sits at the crossroads of several touring routes through the Rockies and Purcell Mountains, making this hotel a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through southeastern BC.
